name: mediterranean-cliff-overhead
image_purpose: swimwear lookbook and high-fashion coastal editorial

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic overhead coastal fashion editorial with two approved adult women arranged symmetrically on contrasting towels beside the Mediterranean.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult women with golden blonde wind-swept beach waves, sun-kissed natural skin, athletic but natural builds, direct camera gaze, and neutral intense expressions. Woman A wears a deep navy crinkle-textured knit bikini; Woman B wears a matte white high-cut technical spandex one-piece with an athletic racer-back silhouette. Both wear large gold hoop earrings.
composition_elements: Direct bird's-eye full-body view, subjects arranged head-to-toe in reciprocal horizontal alignment.
Both lie on their backs with relaxed, symmetrical limbs for a graphic geometric composition.
Coastal limestone cliffside, jagged textured rocks, deep azure sea, and distant white foam.
One pristine white towel and one vibrant crimson towel form sharp color blocks against beige stone.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct midday sun with high-contrast short shadows, crisp highlights, realistic natural skin and fabric texture, and a raw unfiltered high-fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm portrait lens from a directly overhead camera to maintain natural proportions, hyper-realistic detail, high-resolution editorial photography, high saturation in crimson, navy, white, and azure, no text or watermark.
